# FFmpeg Workspace

> A browser-based FFmpeg media workspace for local conversion, preview, and export. Local files are processed on the visitor's device; shared-link remote imports are limited to public HTTPS images fetched through the site's image bridge.

Commands supplied in shared links are prefilled but never run automatically. Browser automation is available through an explicit versioned API and also requires an explicit run call.

## Product documentation

- [Product overview](/index.md): Features, privacy boundaries, browser requirements, and the local processing model.
- [Shared workspace links](/docs/shared-links.md): The `command` prefill and repeatable, image-only `file` query parameters, including limits and failure behavior.
- [Browser automation API](/docs/browser-api.md): The `window.ffmpegWorkspace` v1 contract, readiness, idempotent request IDs, cancellation, file listing, and chunked output reads.

## Optional

- [Deployment notes](/docs/deployment.md): Cloudflare runtime, image bridge, and pinned FFmpeg core delivery.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/lmssiehdev/ffmpeg): Source code and development setup.
